title: A number over 50 characters is refused while on an open part request
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test.
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with a line holding an open part request for part A, requested and not received.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test, on no part request.
  • Use two new part numbers that no part uses, one exactly 51 characters long and one exactly 60 characters long.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with the 51-character number.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Wait 5 seconds.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
  8. Click the part B row.
  9. Replace the Part Number with the 60-character number.
  10. Click Save.
  11. Type the 60-character number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows the 51-character number.

Step 4:

  • Nothing is saved and the window stays open.
  • A red message reads "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request.", with the second, smaller line "Please try to resolve this." (part A is on work order 1's part request).

Step 5:

  • The red message has gone on its own after about 3 seconds.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and part A keeps its number.

Step 7:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 8:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 9:

  • Part Number shows the 60-character number.

Step 10:

  • The window closes: part B saves with the 60-character number, because it is on no open part request.

Step 11:

  • Part B is listed under the 60-character number.

  • S13-N7: “If the new number is longer than 50 characters and the part sits on an open part request, the save is refused with "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Rename over 50 characters with an open part request | "Part number can't be longer than 50 characters while it's on an open part request." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”
